yt_description:
Chasing member renewals by email? Dues unpaid, reminders forgotten, members drifting away.

Build a Community Membership Portal on Stackby. Import your member list and dues tracker, and every membership, tier, chapter, renewal date and payment lives in one place. Automated reminders go out at 30, 7 and 0 days, and members renew and update their own details in a self-service portal.

What's inside
• Member directory by tier and chapter
• Automated renewal reminders
• Dues and payments, paid vs overdue
• Member portal with events and RSVPs

Watch the portal come together in under 8 minutes.
